SVO cites Apollo Mapping's whitepapers page (https://apollomapping.com/about-us/whitepapers), which served a Cloudflare bot challenge and was not verified, so the reseller's terms and the file SVO used are unknown. The curves are SVO Filter Profile Service records recovered from Internet Archive captures (svo2.cab.inta-csic.es did not answer on 2026-10-26); SVO states no licence (page footer '© SVO') and asks for the acknowledgement listed in info.json.
